in_sanskrit.name: सच्चित्

in_marathi.name: Satchit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satchit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from two words, 'Sat' meaning truth and 'Chit' meaning consciousness, Satchit represents the ultimate reality or truth.

in_bengali.name: Satchit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Truth Consciousness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Satchit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from two words, 'Sat' meaning truth and 'Chit' meaning consciousness, Satchit represents the ultimate reality or truth.
